items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 25 at 1:15PM EDT until September 25 at 10:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected along shorelines and tidal waterways (7.3 to 7.5 feet
Mean Lower Low Water at Charleston).

* WHERE...Coastal Colleton and Charleston Counties.

* WHEN...From 6 PM to 10 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...This could result in some roads becoming impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide will occur around 7:48 PM today
at Charleston. Saltwater inundation will be possible 1 to 2
hours before and after high tide.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Visit water.weather.gov for additional water level and flood
impact information.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 25 at 6:23AM EDT until September 26 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
